review_scope: Six targeted repositories; not an account-wide code audit. Full source was read only for two named modules. No upstream runtime was executed.
retrieval: Connected GitHub GET and public web pages. Binary archive retrieval from the runtime was unavailable; no successful cloning is claimed.
identity_notes: Git tree and blob identifiers below are not presented as commit identifiers. Main-branch URLs can change.

repositories.observed: Research corpus organization, DIKWP literature ledger and gap mining. Runnable distribution is a root ZIP.
repositories.limit: The inspected tree does not expose an installable source root. ZIP internals were not inspected; absence of numerical code inside it is not established.
repositories.extension: Flat installable source tree, single-file executable, tests and executable chapter labs.

repositories.inspection: README, source tree and full analysis CLI
repositories.observed: closure() subtracts fixed missingness and contradiction penalties from an input quality value. analyze() exports records, roles and seeded claims.
repositories.limit: This inspected numerical score is not calibrated confidence. Nonfinite values are not rejected along the inspected path; isolated NaN expression yields 100. Contradictory evidence is mechanically penalized without assessing study validity.
repositories.extension: Strict finite JSON, no truth score, competing executable models, negative controls, a synthetic-record file adapter preserving quality only as an annotation.

repositories.observed: Liver workflow, triage routing, preparation and handoff governance; explicitly not diagnosis or prescribing. Source distributed as ZIP.
repositories.limit: Clinical workflow governance is a different problem from a book-based experimental mechanism engine. Archive internals were not inspected.
repositories.extension: Separate educational model research from patient workflows; no automated clinical bridge or imported patient records.

repositories.inspection: README, module directory and full evaluator.py
repositories.observed: Actual numerical evaluation, exact integer-knapsack reference, frozen-model comparisons, per-world nonregression and descriptive paired bootstrap. README documents explicit review and rollback.
repositories.limit: Inspected evaluator handles basis-regression rows and scheduling cases. It is not a history-dependent organ-model evaluator or partial-observation viability solver. Row-level resampling should not be reused blindly for autocorrelated time points.
repositories.extension: Equally weighted whole-trajectory losses, train/development/audit separation, mechanism alternatives, finite belief-state game and correction-aware lineage. No claim that ASCENT lacked numerical computation.

repositories.observed: Memory, coadaptation and accounting themes; explicit distinction between local order, thermodynamic entropy and moral value. Root ZIP carries distribution.
repositories.limit: README-level conceptual scope cannot establish correctness of a numerical physical implementation; archive internals were not inspected.
repositories.extension: Dimensioned finite-volume mass balance, separate energy balance and reaction-direction check, without equating reserve with joules or local order with virtue.

repositories.observed: Claim-evidence mapping, missing evidence, demotion, correction and reversible review; expressly a local verification scaffold rather than a truth oracle.
repositories.limit: A declared ledger does not by itself show how numerical experiments, source corrections and downstream proposals are connected. Runtime source was not inspected.
repositories.extension: Executable SQLite dependency DAG, immutable node versions, typed scopes, recursive correction propagation and externally anchored manifest verification.
